name: La Guijarrosa (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Guijarrosa (a tower, a tree, waves and clasped hands).
history: Municipal flag of La Guijarrosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Guijarrosa arms — tower, tree, waves and clasped hands
